snapshot.text: Free public services alongside the faith-based CHAM network, heavily donor-funded. The new government faces ambulance shortages and stalled hospital projects, and is pushing to eliminate neglected tropical diseases.

priorities.title: Ambulances and stalled hospitals
priorities.text: The government plans to tackle ambulance shortages and finish stalled hospital projects.

priorities.title: Eliminating NTDs
priorities.text: Malawi is intensifying elimination of neglected tropical diseases and hosted Africa's NTD meeting.

priorities.title: Sanitation order
priorities.text: A landmark public health sanitation order was adopted.
